question: Does the pre-download-frozen new family supply at least two complementary target views on each side and one visible same-scene sibling before RGB or descriptor access?

selection.memory: Greedily add maximum newly visible target vertices; ties use larger short-side fraction, higher depth-visible ratio, then earlier frame.
selection.sibling: Use the first different door/doorframe instance in frozen metadata order that has any admitted view, then choose its maximum-visible view with the same deterministic ties.

next_action.evaluable: Freeze up to three target views per side and the selected sibling, then run the unchanged nearest-member object-context descriptor once.
next_action.not_evaluable: Retain the source receipt and do not open RGB or call DINOv2 for this family.

forbidden_after_freeze: change family, target, view rules, memory budget or sibling order
reinterpret source scarcity as algorithm failure
claim_boundary: This source gate can establish only whether the new family supplies bounded target memory and a same-scene sibling challenge. It is not descriptor evidence, exact-instance binding, named entrance, ownership, access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, handoff, benefit, reliability or safety.
